case_classification.short_description: Small DCF (no forecasting, estimates given) with two-stage TV and sensitivity analysis regarding three factors (combinatorial sensitivity analysis)

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: The task requires constructing a comprehensive DCF model with several complex elements: reconstructing Free Cash Flows from high-level balance sheet and income statement items (computing NWC and Capex), setting up an iterative WACC loop that resolves circularity via Excel's iterative calculation, discounting cash flows to a non-standard valuation date using fractional periods, and modeling a two-stage terminal value. Furthermore, because the sensitivity analysis requires varying three distinct inputs (g1 rate, g1 end year, and g2 rate) across 35 unique scenarios, a standard Excel Data Table cannot be used directly. The modeler will need to write a VBA macro or build a complex multi-variable formula scenario manager to populate the answers efficiently, adding significant time for setup and verification.
